Parameter.TargetData: What type of data shall be received by the target (Localities, PostalCode, or Streets).
Parameter.Country: The optional country to retrieve the data of (if not provided either the country specified in the CodBi's Configuration OpenPLZ_Country will be used or, if not specified, de).
Parameter.CSSProposals: The CSS-Style for the proposals-Select-Element appearing when there are multiple matches.
Parameter.MsgNotKnown: The message to show when trying to set a value that can't be found in OpenPLZ.
Parameter.Dependent: The CSS-Selector of the field whose value restricts the search results. Prefer DependentPLZ / DependentLocality for streets.
Parameter.DependentPLZ: The CSS-Selector of the field that restricts the search of streets by its value resembling a postal-code, only if DependentLocality is undefined.
Parameter.DependentLocality: The CSS-Selector of the field that restricts the search of streets by its value resembling a locality (overwrites DependentPLZ).
Parameter.FocusOnAutocomplete: The CSS-Selector of the field to focus when an autocomplete has occurred.
Parameter.AllowEmpty: If set to true an empty input value won't trigger an error message.
Parameter.AllowedValues: A CSV of additional values that are also accepted without requiring an OpenPLZ match (bypasses the not known validation). Use semicolons to optionally restrict a value to a specific dependent locality and/or PLZ.

TargetData.description: What type of data shall be received by the target (Localities, PostalCode, or Streets).
TargetData.descriptionDe: Welche Art von Daten vom Ziel empfangen werden soll (Localities, PostalCode oder Streets).
TargetData.descriptionIt: Quale tipo di dati deve ricevere il target (Localities, PostalCode o Streets).

Country.description: The optional country to retrieve the data of (if not provided either the country specified in the CodBi's Configuration OpenPLZ_Country will be used or, if not specified, de).
Country.descriptionDe: Das optionale Land, aus dem die Daten abgerufen werden sollen (wenn nicht angegeben, wird entweder das in der CodBi-Konfiguration OpenPLZ_Country angegebene Land verwendet oder, wenn nicht angegeben, de).
Country.descriptionIt: Il paese opzionale da cui recuperare i dati (se non fornito, verrà usato il paese specificato nella configurazione OpenPLZ_Country di CodBi o, se non specificato, de).

CSSProposals.description: The CSS-Style for the proposals-Select-Element appearing when there are multiple matches.
CSSProposals.descriptionDe: Der CSS-Stil für das Vorschlags-Select-Element, das erscheint, wenn es mehrere Übereinstimmungen gibt.
CSSProposals.descriptionIt: Lo stile CSS per l'elemento Select dei suggerimenti che appare quando ci sono più corrispondenze.

MsgNotKnown.description: The message to show when trying to set a value that can't be found in OpenPLZ.
MsgNotKnown.descriptionDe: Die Meldung, die angezeigt wird, wenn versucht wird, einen Wert zu setzen, der in OpenPLZ nicht gefunden werden kann.
MsgNotKnown.descriptionIt: Il messaggio da mostrare quando si tenta di impostare un valore che non può essere trovato in OpenPLZ.

Dependent.description: The CSS-Selector of the field whose value restricts the search results. Prefer DependentPLZ / DependentLocality for streets.
Dependent.descriptionDe: Der CSS-Selektor des Felds, dessen Wert die Suchergebnisse einschränkt. Für Straßen DependentPLZ / DependentLocality bevorzugen.
Dependent.descriptionIt: Il selettore CSS del campo il cui valore limita i risultati di ricerca. Preferire DependentPLZ / DependentLocality per le strade.

DependentPLZ.description: The CSS-Selector of the field that restricts the search of streets by its value resembling a postal-code, only if DependentLocality is undefined.
DependentPLZ.descriptionDe: Der CSS-Selektor des Felds, das die Suche nach Straßen anhand seines Werts, der einer Postleitzahl ähnelt, einschränkt, nur wenn DependentLocality undefined ist.
DependentPLZ.descriptionIt: Il selettore CSS del campo che limita la ricerca delle strade in base al suo valore simile a un codice postale, solo se DependentLocality è undefined.

DependentLocality.description: The CSS-Selector of the field that restricts the search of streets by its value resembling a locality (overwrites DependentPLZ).
DependentLocality.descriptionDe: Der CSS-Selektor des Felds, das die Suche nach Straßen anhand seines Werts, der einer Ortschaft ähnelt, einschränkt (überschreibt DependentPLZ).
DependentLocality.descriptionIt: Il selettore CSS del campo che limita la ricerca delle strade in base al suo valore simile a una località (sovrascrive DependentPLZ).

FocusOnAutocomplete.description: The CSS-Selector of the field to focus when an autocomplete has occurred.
FocusOnAutocomplete.descriptionDe: Der CSS-Selektor des Felds, das fokussiert werden soll, wenn eine automatische Vervollständigung stattgefunden hat.
FocusOnAutocomplete.descriptionIt: Il selettore CSS del campo su cui focalizzare quando si è verificato un autocomplete.

AllowEmpty.description: If set to true an empty input value won't trigger an error message.
AllowEmpty.descriptionDe: Wenn auf true gesetzt, löst ein leerer Eingabewert keine Fehlermeldung aus.
AllowEmpty.descriptionIt: Se impostato su true, un valore di input vuoto non attiva un messaggio di errore.

AllowedValues.description: A CSV of additional values that are also accepted without requiring an OpenPLZ match (bypasses the not known validation). Use semicolons to optionally restrict a value to a specific dependent locality and/or PLZ.
AllowedValues.descriptionDe: Eine CSV zusätzlicher Werte, die ebenfalls ohne einen OpenPLZ-Abgleich akzeptiert werden (umgeht die 'nicht bekannt'-Validierung). Verwenden Sie Semikolons, um einen Wert optional auf eine bestimmte abhängige Ortschaft und/oder PLZ einzuschränken.
AllowedValues.descriptionIt: Un CSV di valori aggiuntivi accettati anche senza una corrispondenza OpenPLZ (bypassa la validazione 'non noto'). Usa i punti e virgola per limitare facoltativamente un valore a una specifica località dipendente e/o PLZ.
